queries.monthly_trend: SELECT segments.year, segments.month, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.conversions, metrics.all_conversions FROM customer WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY segments.year, segments.month
queries.conversion_actions: SELECT conversion_action.name, conversion_action.type, conversion_action.category, conversion_action.status FROM conversion_action WHERE conversion_action.status='ENABLED'
queries.genuine_by_category: SELECT segments.month, segments.conversion_action_category, metrics.conversions FROM customer WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '2023-12-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY segments.month
queries.campaigns_history: SELECT campaign.name, campaign.status, segments.month, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions FROM campaign WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '2025-06-01' AND '2026-07-31' AND metrics.cost_micros > 0 ORDER BY segments.month
queries.search_terms: SELECT search_term_view.search_term, metrics.clicks FROM search_term_view WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS ORDER BY metrics.clicks DESC LIMIT 15

takeover_evidence: First PPC Guru-named campaign ('PPC Guru - Psychotherapy Lead Search', id 23509922782) began spending January 2026 ($128, 2 conv) and scaled from February 2026 ($2,006, 36 conv). Pre-2026 campaigns carried other naming conventions (e.g. 'CA Therapy Villa | Search Campaign | generic', 'DM I Performance Max', 'Aug Generic Reworked', 'Trauma Therapy Campaign_TDS'), indicating a prior/other setup. PPC Guru takeover = January 2026. Dedicated PHONE_CALL_LEAD tracking also appears only from 2026.
genuine_leads_by_category_note: Raw metrics.conversions is contaminated in this account: many months set OUTBOUND_CLICK (book_a_free_consult / phone-number button clicks) and PAGE_VIEW as counting conversions (e.g. Jul 2025 OUTBOUND_CLICK = 142.75, Aug 2025 = 108). Genuine leads recomputed from segments.conversion_action_category = PHONE_CALL_LEAD + SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM + CONTACT + BOOK_APPOINTMENT (+ PURCHASE where present). See calculations.json.
notes: Takeover = January 2026 (first PPC Guru campaign live). Baseline period = calendar 2025 (pre-PPC-Guru, prior setup); 'now' = Q2 2026 (first complete quarter fully under PPC Guru management).

Massive Display-style impression spikes in Oct-Nov 2025 (161,840 then 491,790 impressions) with near-zero genuine leads indicate a prior broad/Performance Max misfire that was later cleaned up; Nov-Dec 2025 produced 0 genuine leads.

Dedicated phone-call tracking (PHONE_CALL_LEAD) exists only from 2026, so pre-2026 genuine-lead counts UNDERSTATE true demand (calls were not captured). The reported before/after growth is therefore conservative.
OUTBOUND_CLICK, PAGE_VIEW, GET_DIRECTIONS and CONVERTED_LEAD categories excluded from genuine leads.
Confidence Medium: rich data but a messy multi-campaign pre-history and only ~6 months / one complete quarter under PPC Guru.
